description: This Java class defines the ResetConnectionLogsStrategy, which handles the ResetConnectionLogs command within the connection management module. It extends an abstract strategy class and specifies behavior for generating responses and actions related to resetting connection logs.

classes.name: ResetConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractEphemeralStrategy specialized for ResetConnectionLogs command handling.

methods.name: ResetConnectionLogsStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the ResetConnectionLogs class type.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a response indicating the reset of connection logs, associating the current connection state ID with provided headers.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of ConnectionAction enums to broadcast to client actors if started and to send a response.
